name: OpenVan MCP Server
description: OpenVan MCP Server exposes OpenVan.camp public APIs over the Model Context Protocol: fuel prices across 125+ countries, VanSky weather suitability scores (0–100), VanBasket food price index, currency exchange rates, vanlife events (expos, festivals, meetups) and aggregated news stories in 7 languages. 11 read-only tools, no authentication, 120 req/min rate limit, CC BY 4.0 license. Remote Streamab
